name: Ranked Bars
description: Ranked rows with each label on a bar showing its share, with tabs for several breakdowns and a fold for long lists.

props.name: data
props.type: { name: string; value: number; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Rows for a single list, drawn in the order given; sort them first for a ranking. Bars are scaled to the largest row, and the share beside each is of the list's total.

props.name: groups
props.type: { id: string; name: string; data: { name: string; value: number; icon?: ReactNode }[] }[]
props.description: Several breakdowns of the same total, each behind an underline tab. Takes the place of data.

props.name: selectedGroup
props.description: The id of the tab shown, when you control it.

props.name: defaultSelectedGroup
props.description: The id of the tab shown first.

props.name: onGroupChange
props.description: Called with the id of the tab chosen.

props.name: limit
props.description: Rows shown before the list folds. The last one fades and a Show all button opens the rest.

props.name: color
props.description: Bar colour. The bars are a pale tint of it with a solid leading edge.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes each row's value. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatShare
props.description: Writes each row's share of the list's total, given as a fraction. Defaults to whole percents.

props.name: showAllLabel
props.description: Text of the button that opens a folded list.

props.name: showLessLabel
props.description: Text of the button that folds it again.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card. Also names the list for screen readers.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. "last 30 days".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note, action, footer, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
